purpose: Investigate the existing mode-interference/current-association gap. No width admission or physical boundaries inferred by EOF rank.
source_layer_context: OSCAR near-surface product; paper describes top30m support, not a direct15m measurement.
overlap_rule: New and retained equatorial rows must match timestamps, both components and missingness exactly. Abort on disagreement; never silently overwrite.
calendar_boundary_rule: Preserve returned originals and exclude all samples outside1995-2016; report exclusions and time gaps.
monthly_operator: Equal-record monthly means of complete u/v pairs; at least5 complete pairs per cell.264 calendar months required.
missing_rule: Drop a latitude from a fit if any of264 monthly cells is deficient; report every dropped latitude. No gap filling or velocity imputation.
mean_removal: Subtract the264-month mean at each retained latitude; retain seasonal variability. Author description does not supply code or exact weighting/domain; this is an OSW experiment, not exact reproduction.
decomposition: Unstandardized unweighted covariance SVD; monthly rows and latitude columns. Store unit-norm spatial vectors, PC=left_vector*singular_value and variance fractions=squared_singular_value/sum.
orientation_rule: Largest absolute spatial loading positive for each mode; sign has no standalone flow-direction meaning.
mode_identity_rule: Report loading energy/peak latitude and PC annual/semiannual harmonics; never equate rank3 with SECC automatically or tune domains to published percentages.
column_rule: Keep native columns as separate fits. No fictitious observed80.5E section or pooled uncertainty interval.
